info.title: OpenServiceNOW API
info.description:
Phase 1 foundation API. The backend is authoritative for authentication, tenant scope and RBAC.
Every API response includes a server-generated X-Request-ID header; client-supplied request IDs are not trusted.
All MySQL BIGINT identifiers and cursor IDs are serialized as decimal strings to preserve precision in JavaScript clients.

get.description: Minimal context is available during forced password change, with an empty permissions list. Every authenticated endpoint except GET /me, POST /password and POST /logout is denied with PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED until the flag is cleared.

post.x-conditional-authorization: If the group has a system role, the caller must be an effective platform administrator.

get.description: Lists members of a security/RBAC group in the authenticated tenant. Requires admin.rbac.manage and admin.users.manage.
Lists direct role assignments for a tenant member. Requires admin.rbac.manage and admin.users.manage.
Lists roles directly assigned to an RBAC group in the authenticated tenant. Requires admin.rbac.manage.

Reports whether a migrated empty installation needs its first administrator. When required, returns a token and sets opensnow_setup (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, 20 minutes). Responses must not be cached.

Set-Cookie.description: Installer CSRF cookie, only before installation is complete

post.description: Creates the first organization, local administrator, membership, platform_admin role and audit event in one transaction. Permanently closes installation. Requires same-origin JSON and matching cookie/header tokens from GET /api/v1/setup. Existing accounts cannot be replaced. Concurrent/replayed attempts return 409. No login session is created; sign in afterward.

422.description: Invalid organization, account or password data

put.description: Updates the authenticated global identity only; membership permissions grant no authority over another identity. Unavailable until a required password change is completed.

204.description: Completed; repeat revocation is a no-op.

500.description: Operation failed; transaction errors before commit leave credentials and sessions unchanged.

409.description: Version conflict. Reload /me and explicitly decide before retrying. Local input must be retained.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Must match the current CSRF cookie and server-side hash.

post.description: Atomically changes global credentials, revokes all other sessions across organizations and rotates the current session and CSRF cookies in place. Requires the current password and credential version. Available during forced password change. A stale/repeated old request cannot commit twice. If the response is lost, reload /me or log in with the new password; do not automatically retry. Errors before commit leave credentials and sessions unchanged. No secret is returned in JSON.

Set-Cookie.description: Rotated HttpOnly session and readable CSRF cookies; SameSite=Strict.

500.description: ACCOUNT_RESULT_UNKNOWN means the SQL COMMIT acknowledgement was lost and the outcome must be reconciled via /me or a fresh login. Do not retry automatically. Errors before COMMIT roll back the entire password/session/audit transaction.

409.description: Version conflict. Reload /me and explicitly decide before retrying. Local input must be retained.

429.description: Account-global or IP attempt limit reached.

503.description: Argon2 concurrency limit or limiter unavailable. Retry-After is supplied for AUTH_BUSY.
